scenes.narration: Microduck learned to walk in a simulation before it ever took a real step.
scenes.on_screen_text: Learned to walk before step one
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real presenter shot of an Indian man about 35, calm and curious, in a tidy studio, gesturing toward the camera with a slight smile, medium shot
scenes.speaker: Arjun

scenes.narration: Hugging Face's Microduck is a 25-centimetre walking robot, under 800 grams. Hugging Face's CEO says it's heading for about 20,000 preorders.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real close-up of a small desktop walking robot standing on a wooden table, soft studio light, shallow depth of field, slight low angle
scenes.speaker: Meera

scenes.narration: Fifteen motors, a camera, a depth sensor, and a beak that lifts about 100 grams. It walks, crouches, gets up after falls, and can even roller-skate.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real macro shot of small robot servo motors and wiring on a workbench, electronics lab, overhead angle
scenes.speaker: Arjun

scenes.narration: So how? Reinforcement learning in a physics simulator. Fall, retry, improve... Then the skill transfers to the real robot. That's sim-to-real.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real shot of an Indian woman about 29, warm and sharp, in a bright studio, raising one eyebrow as she asks a question to camera, medium shot
scenes.speaker: Meera

scenes.narration: At Nvidia GTC Berlin, Jensen Huang demoed four live. They stumbled and wandered. Real floors are hard.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real wide shot of small robots wobbling on a floor at a tech conference stage, audience blurred in background
scenes.speaker: Arjun

scenes.narration: The software is open source. The hardware designs aren't, according to Pollen.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real over-the-shoulder shot of a developer's laptop showing lines of code, desk with small robot parts beside it
scenes.speaker: Meera

scenes.narration: $399 before tax and shipping. New orders: about four to six months. A 16-plus dev platform, not a toy.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real shot of a young Indian woman about 22 with a shoulder bag, kurta top and denim, looking at her phone with a curious small smile in a metro station
scenes.speaker: Arjun
